slot.brief: simplify a composite like sin⁻¹(x) + cos⁻¹(x) or tan⁻¹(x) + cot⁻¹(x) inside a nested expression using standard identities

stem: The value of sin(2 sin^(-1) x + cos^(-1) x) at x = 1/3 is

verdicts.working: Using cos⁻¹x = π/2 − sin⁻¹x, the angle simplifies to sin⁻¹x + π/2. Thus the value is cos(sin⁻¹(1/3)) = √(1 − 1/9) = 2√2/3.

working:
2 sin^(-1) x + cos^(-1) x = (pi/2) + sin^(-1) x. So the expression is sin(pi/2 + sin^(-1) x) = cos(sin^(-1) x) = sqrt(1 - x^2) = sqrt(8/9) = (2 sqrt 2)/3.

Independent check: Using cos⁻¹x = π/2 − sin⁻¹x, the angle simplifies to sin⁻¹x + π/2. Thus the value is cos(sin⁻¹(1/3)) = √(1 − 1/9) = 2√2/3.
